rationale: Adds the pulp deps script command (C++ and Rust command tables, docs/status/cli-commands.yaml, docs/reference/cli.md, the tooling disposition map as pulp-owned) that delegates to tools/toolchain/deps.py for Pulp's own build-toolchain pins. It reads and reports host tool versions, fetches pinned dependency sources through the existing setup.sh --deps-only, and edits the toolchain manifest on request. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; no design output or package format changes.
